description: AI Sense Enrichment result schema. Source fields are immutable; AI fills only enrichment fields.

fields.part_of_speech_normalized: enum: noun, verb, adjective, adverb, pronoun, preposition, conjunction, particle, auxiliary, numeral, measure_word, classifier, interjection, complement, other

rules: Never modify source_id, band, source_number, canonical_word, pinyin, meaning_english, or sense_group_id.
Do not create a new sense unless the source meaning/pinyin/POS clearly requires it.
When meaning is ambiguous, preserve source wording and set review_flag=true.
Examples must use the target sense naturally and not introduce advanced vocabulary unnecessarily.
Use simplified Chinese matching the source vocabulary.
